v4HistoricalRule.role: HISTORICAL V4 selector contract: one band-conditional arm (H0 -> Nexus-else-S0, H2 -> S0). Final negative verdict. Not the arm-stress selection rule and not a comparator of H-W1.

scoringContract.note: comparator outputs used for SCORING are the frozen set-valued arms on the original view (as in the feasibility lane).

policyInputContract.rule: S0 and Nexus are re-run on the transformed view. A comparator output enters only as an identity-free projection (membership of an action key in the S0 top set; the key of the Nexus recommendation; rationale codes). A projection that is not stable under relabelling counts against the policy in the invariance test.
policyInputContract.note: what the policy may SEE of a comparator: key-based projections only, recomputed on every transformed view; an unstable projection is excluded as a feature (decided at I-0 fixture gates).

comparators.distinction: The prospective identity-free comparator contract (two independent arms, S0 and Nexus-else-S0, scored on every admitted class, projections re-run per view) is distinct from the historical V4 band rule (H0 -> Nexus-else-S0, H2 -> S0, one arm). No silent substitution: the V4 rule appears only as a recorded historical contract.
